samples.claim: with_log2_num_bytes takes an exponent despite doc wording about number of bytes, clamps it to[5,27], allocates a zero byte vector of1<<clamped exponent, then parses/copies it into block storage through new().unwrap(). The unwrap is guarded by a positive multiple-of32 allocation; peak construction holds both vectors temporarily. with_ndv_fpp accepts range[0,1), including0 and signed negative zero, and rejects1,negative nonzero,NaN/infinity. It estimates an exponent then applies the same clamp, so requested probability is not guaranteed when size saturates.

samples.claim: Private error_source_is_not_found(source:&(dyn std::error::Error+'static))->bool first downcasts Lance Error and delegates is_not_found, thereby respecting its deliberate negative cases; then object_store::Error matches NotFound or recursively inspects its source; all other errors recurse through source(). No std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound or message matching is performed. There is no visited-set/depth guard for pathological cyclic/custom source chains.
samples.review_note: Matches recursive typed-source traversal without IO-kind/text recognition or cycle/depth guard; earlier same-turn is_not_found review confirms deliberate negative cases.

samples.claim: TempStdPath likewise creates a TempDir, formats its normalized string with fixed leaf /some_file, converts it to PathBuf, and retains both. The comment calls its form Windows URI-safe; stored value is a PathBuf rather than a URI type.
